notes.title: Gabriel's route is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41706664/3a8cce72ef66ff987122bf706142fc5f90165a3a.png[/img]


That's right! The handsome boss route is finished!

This route adds 43k words to the game and many new illustrations! Besides, the images gallery has been checked and eight more achievements have been added.

[b]Missing features[/b] so far:

- A few lunch scenes with the other love interests are missing.

- Text messages with Gabriel are available in his route. Others might still be missing.

- An extra scene, set after the end with Gabriel, will be added soon (it was a Kickstarter request, but it doesn't fit the structure of the routes, which all finish at the same given moment).

About the missing scenes: text messages and lunch convos with other than the love interest are the "friendship route" with those characters, and follow their own storyline. That's the reason they will be added a bit later. I'm sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Update fixing images path not found
notes.content:
Hi,

Some players are finding an annoying error at the start of the game; it's a series of error screens that can be simply ignored, but I'd rather make a new build with those error screens out.

The bug itself will be solved in a few hours. Please, allow us some time to test again what went wrong.

Remember that in games made in renpy you can save your game and then, when a new patch is available, you simply need to either load your saved game, or start anew but playing on "Skip" mode: it will quickly advance until it finds any scene or line you haven't seen yet, so you don't miss a single thing!

notes.title: Exes Assault!! is in Early Access!
notes.content:
Ooops, it seems we went slightly out of scope with the game!  The final version will be longer, with more illustrations, and with more features than we initially planned. And that's a good thing, right?! However, that means we are behind schedule, and that's not so good. I feel bad for making people wait so much without a release date in view.

Hence, we have decided to put the game on Early Access, to share the two available routes so far. Let's check what is ready to play right now!

The Early Access version of Exes Assault!! features:

* Jacob and Ivaan's routes.

* 150k words.

* Many cutscene illustrations.

* Business trips, dates, and a waterpark special event!

* Chat with the potential boyfriends and get closer to them!

* English only.

For the full version, we are planning on:

* Gabriel and Kevin's routes.

* A polyamory route with Jacob and Gabriel.

* Full translation into Spanish and Catalan (and maybe more languages).

Gabriel's route is currently 60% done, so keep tuned for updates! Consider following us on Twitter/ X or Discord to get more frequent news about the game!
